notes.title: Battle Stage added (Medieval Castle) & effect enhancement
notes.content:
Added Medieval Castle area to Battle Mode.

A large amount of reinforcements appeared in the Medieval Castle. 
Strategy is important for victory.

Enhanced missile weapon effects.

tags.feature: Added Medieval Castle area to Battle Mode.

notes.title: Enhance effects Part 2, other fixes
notes.content:
Enhanced the effect of the Final Boss. 
Adjusted to make it easier for enemies thrown outside the stage to die.
Changed to be able to destroy roads and towers on EX-6 stage
